items.q: Hi, good morning!
I'm Daniel, I'm a first year medical student.
Can I just check your full name and date of birth?
Did you manage to find parking ok?
How are you doing today?
items.note: social greeting, not a symptom screen

items.q: So what are you here for today?
Do you have any medical problems?
Have you ever been diagnosed with anything like asthma or diabetes?
any regular meds?
Do you take any vitamins or supplements?
any alergies?
Do you react badly to any medicines, like penicillin?
items.note: mentions medicines but asks about reactions

items.q: Are you having any pain anywhere today?
Any symptoms bothering you at the moment?
Feeling unwell in any way?
Do you smoke?
Any heart problems in your family?
items.note: family history not in case; 'problems' should not pull to general health

items.q: Sorry, could you say that again?
Do you know your blood group?
So I'm going to do a full head-to-toe exam, starting with your hands and working my way up.
Are you happy for me to go ahead and examine you?
Could you lie down flat on the couch for me?
What's your favourite colour?
Thank you so much for your time.
That's everything, you can get dressed now. Have a lovely day!
